frontmatter.name: social-autopost
frontmatter.description: Download image posts from Facebook, Instagram or LinkedIn URLs to local folders with post-clone, or publish Facebook personal/group posts with post-person and post-group. Use for cloning a post or latest image posts from a user, fanpage or company, and for explicit Facebook publishing requests.
